source.section: Possible counterexamples with max(deg P,deg Q) <= 150

gate_status.G1: INFERRED (chart_exponent rule is not published; the retraction shape and its two published counterexamples are CHECKED)
gate_status.G3: PROVED (contact_lemma.py, 64/64) -- but lam requires the corner's Phi, which is published nowhere
gate_status.G4: PROVED gate + CHECKED reduction engine (passport_75_125.py 81/81, engine reproduces 5 published GGHV22 reductions)
